sentences.text: Ramcharan Tandan vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 13 March, 2024

High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Cra No. 526 of 2024

Ramcharan Tandan S/o Dhansingh Tandan Aged About 30 Years R/o Rikokala,
 Thana- Rajadevri, Dist. Balodabazar-Bhatapara, C.G.

---- Ap
 Versus
  State Of Chhattisgarh Through The Dist. Magistrate Balodabazar, Dist.
 Balodabazar-Bhatapara, C.G.
 ---- Respo
Mr. Sumit Shrivastava , Counsel for the Appellant.
Mrs. Prabha Sharma, Panel Lawyer for the State/ Respondent.

Heard on I.A. No. 01/2024, an application filed under Section 389 of Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973, seeking suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

By virtue of the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 06.02.2024, passed by the first Additional Sessions Judge Balodabazar, distt- Balodabazar- Bhatapara in S.T. No.
39/2022, whereby the appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:
Conviction Sentences Under Section 498A of Indian Imprisonment for three years and fine of Rs.
Penal Code 2,000/- in default of fine additional R.I. for three months.
Learned Counsel appearing for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in connection with the alleged crime.
It is contended further that the appellant has served two months eight days of jail sentence out of three years and he was on bail during trial.
Since the appeal will take some considerable time for its conclusion, therefore, the jail sentence as awarded by the Trial Court be kept in abeyance, till the disposal of this appeal.
On the other hand, learned counsel appearing for the Respondent/State has opposed the said application.
Having considered the aforesaid contention of the parties, considering the nature of incident and act committed by the appellant.
I am, therefore, inclined to allow this application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail, without further commenting anything on the merits of this case.

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A. No. 01/2024 is allowed and it is directed that the substantive jail sentence imposed upon the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal and he shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.10,000/- along with two surety of Rs. 10,000/- each in like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his appearance before the Registry on 04.04.2024.

He shall thereafter appear before the Trial Court on a date be given by the Registry of this Court and shall continue to appear on all such subsequent dates as are given to him by the said Court till the disposal of this appeal.
In view of above, I.A. No. 01/2024, stands disposed of.
Call for records from the concerned Tribunal.
List this case thereafter.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Arvind Kumar Verma)
